meta.meaning: Documented teacher verification: a named, authorised subject teacher actually examined the resource against the stated syllabus and approved it. This is the fourth, separate concept beside automated structural checks, repository-side specification verification (pending-review-*.json) and the accountable-teacher credit (reviewStatus 'reviewed', D-379). A record here is never created from a teacher credit, a reviewNote or a specCheck; it is added only when the teacher's own check is evidenced.

fields.resource: resource slug (file name without .md) in src/content/resources/
fields.reviewer: author profile id with isReviewer: true whose profile covers the resource's boards and subject
fields.board: board slug; must be one of the resource's boards
fields.date: YYYY-MM-DD the check was completed; not in the future, not before publishedDate
fields.scope: what was checked, e.g. 'whole page' or 'sections 2.1-2.3 and all worked answers'
fields.sources: official documents used (URLs); at least one on the board's official domain
fields.corrections: commits or descriptions of corrections required/made ([] if none)
fields.evidence: where the teacher's own record is kept (e.g. signed form reference, email date); never a placeholder
fields.contentSha256: sha256 of the resource as checked: LF line endings, without the reviewNote, featured and order frontmatter lines (npm run qa:review-pack prints it). Added by D-465: a later edit makes the approval stale (REVERIFICATION_REQUIRED in the Academic QA scorecard).
